title: Strong controlling contrary authority exists
constitution: §25 deliberately search for contrary authority; §24 adverse authority is high-risk; §44 adverse authority

input.question: Can the distributor defendant obtain dismissal of the failure-to-warn claims on impossibility preemption?

expected: The contrary authority is in the local record and resolves in scope; claims that characterize adverse authority are tagged high-risk. With a model, a verification of an answer that ignores Wyeth is not 'verified' once Wyeth's text is in the source set.
passCriteria: resolveCitation('555 U.S. 555', Depo-Provera scope).state === 'resolved' && ref.title matches /Wyeth/
[model] verifyClaims('No controlling authority rejects an impossibility-preemption defense to a failure-to-warn claim.', [Wyeth text]).status !== 'verified'
